brief.job: Get a first-time visitor to paste a script and start a practice session

content.tagline: Practice out loud and watch your pace fix itself.

gallery.caption: Paste a script, give it a title, go.
The words scroll. You just have to say them.

features.name: Teleprompter
features.subtitle: Your script, paced for the room
features.description: A fullscreen scrolling script highlights the sentence you're on and fades the rest, with font-size controls so it reads at arm's length or across a room.

features.name: Live Pace & Filler Tracking
features.subtitle: Every ‘um’ counted while you talk
features.description: The Web Speech API tracks words-per-minute and flags filler words in real time as you speak, so the habit shows up while it's still happening, not after.

features.name: Pause Detection
features.subtitle: Know when the room went quiet
features.description: The Web Audio API monitors volume and flags pauses past 1.5 seconds. Long silences cost points in the score, the same way they'd cost attention in the room.

features.name: Local Session Recording
features.subtitle: Webcam and mic, saved as MP4
features.description: Practice sessions record locally using WebCodecs and download as an MP4 from the report page. The file never leaves the browser unless the download button does.

features.name: Score & Breakdown
features.subtitle: Pace, fillers, and pauses, spelled out
features.description: Score starts at 100 and subtracts the filler count, 5 points per long pause, and a penalty for speaking outside 110–170 words per minute. Sentence-by-sentence pace and a filler timeline back it up.

features.name: Recent Scripts
features.subtitle: Your last 10 sessions, one click away
features.description: Scripts and their last session summary save to the browser's local storage, so picking up a prior rehearsal takes one click, not a re-paste.

principles.title: Nothing leaves your browser
principles.description: Scripts, recordings, and session data stay local. There are no accounts and no servers for practice content.

principles.title: The score is arithmetic, not a verdict
principles.description: It's a fixed formula — filler count, pause count, and pace — not a model guessing at talent. Read it as a nudge, not a grade.

principles.title: No signup between you and a script
principles.description: Paste a script and start. There's no account wall before the first session.

principles.title: Honest about browser support
principles.description: Speech recognition needs Chrome or Edge. Recording needs Chrome 94+ or Safari 16.4+. Everything else degrades gracefully instead of breaking silently.

benefits: Session history stored only on your device
pricing.terms: Speech recognition requires Chrome or Edge; recording requires Chrome 94+ or Safari 16.4+.

faq.q: How is this different from a generic teleprompter app?
faq.a: A teleprompter just scrolls text. This one also tracks pace, flags filler words, detects pauses, and scores the session afterward.

faq.q: Does my script or recording get uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. Scripts, recordings, and session data stay in the browser. The only server call is the feedback form, and that's opt-in.
Speech recognition (pace and filler tracking) needs Chrome or Edge. Session recording needs Chrome 94+ or Safari 16.4+.
100, minus the filler count, minus 5 points per long pause, minus a penalty for speaking outside 110–170 words per minute. No model, just arithmetic.

faq.q: Can I download my practice recording?
faq.a: Yes. If the webcam and mic were on, the report page has a local MP4 download link.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up?
faq.a: No. Paste a script on the dashboard and start practicing.

faq.q: What happens to my recent scripts?
faq.a: The last 10 scripts, and each one's last session summary, save to the browser's local storage, not a server.

faq.q: Is this ready for phones and tablets?
faq.a: Not yet. It relies on desktop-grade Web Speech and WebCodecs APIs, so it's built and tested for desktop Chrome, Edge, and Safari.
